scenario_text:
Our ops lead keeps saying we should put a caching layer in because that's
what they used on their last project. I'm not convinced. This is the internal
admin console for our support team — about 8 of them use it, and they spend
their time editing customer records rather than reading the same page over and
over. The whole database is around 2 GB. Host is 4 GB RAM, 2 vCPU. Nothing
regulated, but it is real customer data so secure it properly.
